label: sec:headline-conjectures-preamble
html: The Yang–Mills millennium problem asks for the existence of the theory and a strictly positive mass gap. These conjectures recast that problem inside the categorical substrate. We derive the mass gap \Delta_q > 0, and hence confinement, directly from the Frobenius–Hopf structure. This avoids analytic technicalities on \mathbb{R}^4.
